keyVerseDR: "...he breathed on them; and he said to them: Receive ye the Holy Ghost." (Jn 20:22)

level1.title: The Holy Spirit Comes
level1.story: Jesus came to His friends and said, "Peace be with you!" He breathed on them. He said, "Receive the Holy Spirit!"
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What did Jesus give His friends?
How does the Spirit help you?
level1.prayer: Come, Holy Spirit, fill my heart. Amen.

activity.title: Come, Holy Spirit
activity.intro: Color the dove and the flames of the Holy Spirit.
activity.prompt: A dove of the Holy Spirit with flames of fire above the disciples

level2.title: Receive the Holy Spirit
level2.story: On Easter evening, the disciples were behind locked doors for fear. Jesus came and stood in their midst and said, "Peace be to you." He showed them His hands and side, and the disciples were glad. He said, "As the Father hath sent Me, I also send you." When He had said this, He breathed on them and said, "Receive ye the Holy Ghost."
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why did Jesus give the Spirit and the power to forgive?
Which gift of the Spirit do you need most?
actions: Learn the 7 gifts of the Spirit
level2.prayer: Come, Holy Spirit, set my heart on fire. Amen.

art.mainBrief: Upper room: risen Jesus breathing on apostles, dove and soft flames
